WHAT: Maestro setup-keyboard flow handles already-installed state
HOW: The Settings keyboards list shows full text 'WhisnapKeyboard — Whisnap' (not just 'Whisnap'). Maestro substring matching must use the exact entry text.
```yaml
- runFlow:
    when:
      visible: "WhisnapKeyboard — Whisnap"
    file: skip-install.yaml
```
GOTCHA: Both 'WhisnapKeyboard — Whisnap' AND 'Add New Keyboard' appear in the same list simultaneously — checking for the full installed keyboard text is the reliable signal
